security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'

bundle.longDescription: A complete point-of-sale register that runs entirely on this computer. No internet connection, no account and no website are needed: the catalogue, staff and sales are all kept locally.
